sigma_rules.title: ESXi Syslog Configuration Change Via ESXCLI
sigma_rules.author: Cedric Maurugeon

strategies.name: Detection Strategy for Defense Impairment via Prevent Command History Logging across OS platforms.

analytics.name: Analytic 1555
analytics.guidance: Detection of environment variable tampering (HISTFILE, HISTCONTROL, HISTFILESIZE) and absence of expected bash history writes. Correlation of unset or zeroed history variables with active shell sessions is indicative of adversarial evasion.

tuning.description: Specific accounts or groups where history logging must always be enforced.
Correlation period to detect unset/export of history variables during active shells.

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: execve calls modifying HISTFILE or HISTCONTROL via unset/export

log_sources.name: linux:osquery
log_sources.channel: processes modifying environment variables related to history logging

analytics.name: Analytic 1556
analytics.guidance: Detection of bash/zsh history suppression via HISTFILE/HISTCONTROL manipulation and absence of ~/.bash_history updates. Observing environment variable changes tied to terminal processes is a strong indicator.

tuning.description: Different shells (bash, zsh, fish) may require customized monitoring for history tampering.

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Set or unset HIST* variables in shell environment

analytics.name: Analytic 1557
analytics.guidance: Detection of PowerShell history suppression using Set-PSReadLineOption with SaveNothing or altered HistorySavePath. Correlating these options with PowerShell usage highlights adversarial evasion attempts.

tuning.description: List of acceptable PowerShell history save paths for baseline comparison.

analytics.name: Analytic 1558
analytics.guidance: Detection of unset HISTFILE or modified history variables in ESXi shell sessions. Correlation of suspicious shell sessions with no recorded commands despite active usage.

tuning.description: Differentiate root/admin shell sessions from adversarial misuse of ESXi shell.

analytics.name: Analytic 1559
analytics.guidance: Detection of CLI commands that disable history logging such as 'no logging'. Anomalous lack of new commands in session logs while activity persists is a strong signal.

tuning.description: Command syntax differs across Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, etc., requiring vendor-aware tuning.

log_sources.name: networkdevice:cli
log_sources.channel: Commands like 'no logging' or equivalents that disable session history
